# Code of Conduct

**padmap** adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct. The canonical text is maintained at that URL; maintainers agree to enforce it as written.

## Reporting

Concerns may be reported privately to the maintainer, [@Ranzlappen](https://github.com/Ranzlappen), by opening a [private security advisory](../../security/advisories/new) (the only private channel this repo has today) or by direct message on GitHub. Reports are treated confidentially.

> **Maintainer note:** if you would rather receive reports by email, add the address here and in [`SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md). It was deliberately left out so a personal address is not published in a public repo without you choosing to.
